scope: Font notices accompanying the four selected experimental paper PDFs; no blanket rights clearance.
limits: Exact font binary versions have not been independently recovered. Noto/Fira source hashes remain in private build-custody evidence. The selected PDFs contain embedded fonts; no standalone font files are included.
The retained Fira copyright is 2018--2020. Primary v0.3 says 2018 and current main says 2018--2023; the remaining license text is byte-identical. The selected-source notice is preserved unchanged.

The retained DejaVu notice matches the installed Matplotlib notice exactly. Its Bitstream/Arev text matches primary DejaVu 2.37 after whitespace normalization; that upstream package also includes a TeX Gyre Math section. No TeX Gyre Math font appears in the selected cached font tables.
Font-family names alone do not establish exact binary provenance for historical figure dependencies.
These notices do not settle all figure, dataset, privacy, participant, trademark or combined-use rights, or certify scientific validity or finished-product acceptance.

recorded_PDF_font_table_rows.scope: Previously captured selected-PDF font-table rows, not a count of unique font binaries or proof of exact historical versions.
